text.description_html:
Acorn RI6BP, 13" Rough Iron Heart Tip Strap Hinges

Using 3 hinges, the 13" Heart Rough Iron Heavy Strap Hinge is suitable for doors 1-3/8" thick and 32" wide weighing up to 90 pounds. The 13" Heart Tip Heavy Rough Iron Strap Hinge grants an old world charm to any woodworking project, gate, shutter, entry door, or garage door. This strap hinge feature a heart shaped mounting tip. It includes mounting hardware for easy installation. The rough black iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of natural weathered iron.

Also Available Matching:
9" Heart Tip Heavy Rough Iron Strap Hinge
17" Heart Tip Heavy Rough Iron Strap Hinge
20-1/2" Heart Tip Heavy Rough Iron Strap Hinge

Features of the Heart Shaped Rough Iron Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Removable pin and reversible pads for full or half surface application. Includes all necessary hardware.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Specifications for the 13" Heart Tip Strap Hinge:

  • Using 3 hinges, this is suitable for doors 1-3/8" thick and 32" wide up to 90 lbs.
  • Length: 13"
  • Strap Width at hinge: 1-3/8"
  • Gauge: .120
  • Pad Width: 1-3/8"
  • Pad Length: 3-1/8

Sold Individually
